LanguageData.VFM_CustomWeaponProfile_Desc: Add specific weapons here to enable independent configuration. Weapons added to this list will ignore global settings, allowing manual tuning of their parameters across different firing modes.

LanguageData.VFM_AddAllWeapons_Dialog_2: Unless you plan to manually adjust parameters for every weapon, this operation will not bring any performance or balance benefits, and will only make your settings page much more cluttered.
